polityNote: Republic of Colombia throughout. 22 departments, intendancies, commissaries and the Distrito Especial of Bogotá; from 1991-07-04 32 departments and the Capital District.

unresolved.why: Several earlier units are unions of NE atoms (e.g. Vaupés+Guaviare, Caldas+Quindío+Risaralda), but the change list for 1886–1977 is only approximately dated (statoids gives «~1935», «~1942», «~1950») and records transfers between units (Cauca→Antioquia corridor, Caquetá→Putumayo) whose lines run through NE atoms. Not claimed (outside scope).
